summary: Shelfkeeper: A simple personal book lending tracker for one person's home library — catalogue books, mark who borrowed what, and see at a glance what's currently out.
implemented_features: Fix or remove a wrongly entered book
Lend a book and get it back
See everything I own in one list
Filter to just the lent-out books
See how many are lent out right now
assumptions: Built for A single user (the bookshelf owner) on their own computer, keeping track of family book borrowing..
Persistence decision: Browser localStorage with a single JSON array of Book objects under the key 'shelfkeeper.books'.

tests_run.journey: Generated journey suite passed: Add a book, confirm it appears in the list, refresh and confirm it persists; Lend a book, confirm lent count increments and filter shows it, return it, confirm count decrements and filter hides it; Edit a book's title and category, confirm changes persist after refresh; Delete a book, confirm it is gone from the list and count updates; Load with malformed localStorage JSON, confirm app does not crash and starts with empty list
